name: soft-deny-force-push-before-operator
description: A force push with -f after the branch, then a line break (to the shell an operator that ends the command, like `;`) and a second command. Only one of the rule's patterns matches the command, the one ending in ` -f\n*`: both engines must read that escape in a like pattern as a line break.

context.command:
git push origin feat -f
git status
